acceptanceCriteria: Root cause of the LOCK_TIMEOUT under load is identified (test budget vs product lock path)
TestGH494PreparationAdmission passes repeatedly under full ./internal/tasks/... load (e.g. -count=20 with parallel packages) or the budget is made load-independent with the reason recorded
body: Observed 2026-10-04 while verifying the merge of origin/main eeef6276 into PR #518 (branch claude/499-escalation-ladder, head 174154f8), Darwin arm64, go1.27.1, GOTOOLCHAIN=local. During `go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/tasks/...` the `internal/tasks/authority` package failed once on TestGH494PreparationAdmission/total-budget-and-phase-cancellation with LOCK_TIMEOUT (100ms lock timeout). Neither side of the merge touches that package. Rerunning the package alone passed 3/3. Expected: the subtest is deterministic under concurrent package load. Actual: a 100ms lock-wait budget trips under full-suite load. Suspected timing-sensitive test (not a confirmed product defect); related load-sensitivity tickets: V1-0724 (PSR), V1-0727 (liveverify).
title: authority: TestGH494PreparationAdmission LOCK_TIMEOUT under full-suite load
